name: Universal Logistics - Tanner Value-Added Facility - Tanner AL

fieldNotes.location: Resolved to 5271 Endeavor Way NW, Tanner, AL 35671 (ROOFTOP geocode 34.6318,-86.8968). Confirmed via Universal Logistics 'Class A Yard Switcher - Tanner, AL' job posting which lists the in-person apply address as 5271 Endeavor Way; LoopNet/Crexi/Showcase list it as a 2021-built ~300k+ sq ft distribution warehouse with 51 dock doors in SouthPoint Business Park. Street View confirms the office-front warehouse and the spec-built dock yards.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck entrance. The building sits inside SouthPoint Business Park; dock yards open directly onto shared internal park drives. Office-front driveway (Street View, NW face) runs straight to the parking lot with no barrier arm, gate, or pinch-point.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at any approach. No staffed structure visible at the office driveway or the truck-side park drives.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: false because there is no truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The internal park drives and dock aprons provide deep approach room — easily 3+ trucks of stacking before the docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved aprons and abundant unused paved width around the drop yards; ample room to add an express/bypass lane if a gate were ever installed.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Crexi/Showcase listing states 51 dock doors. Satellite corroborates dense dock banks on the SW long face and the NW (office) face with trailers backed in.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large drop yard south/southeast of the building with multiple rows of parked trailers; z20 imagery shows 25+ trailers in marked stalls in the southern yard alone, plus more along the SE.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks run on two distinct faces of the building (NW long face near the office and SW/SE long face), consistent with separate shipping and receiving banks in a cross-dock value-added layout.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural — Tanner is a small Limestone County community; the site is in an edge-of-town spec industrial park (SouthPoint Business Park) beside I-565, with farmland and woods adjacent.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows on the south/southeast side, separate from the active dock aprons.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: siteAreaAcres ~34 estimated from the perimeter box. trailersVisible/Capacity are honest overhead estimates; the building footprint plus drop yard rows are extensive. railServed false — no spur into the property; nearest rail is well off-site.
